title: MatchLab · Platform overview
description: Latest completed snapshot, not live telemetry. Active means active and email-confirmed, not DAU. Registration history excludes deleted accounts. Always inspect data_source and as_of.

charts.title: Open places in visible recruiting projects

title: MatchLab · People and skills
description: Skill groups are inferred by a small published keyword taxonomy, not verified professions or employment. Unknown is a valid segment. Supply counts confirmed active people open to collaboration.

title: MatchLab · Projects and recruitment
description: Role demand and skill demand can overlap: one place may require several skills. Two-role share is a CURRENT snapshot proxy across all projects, not the historical pilot success metric from the SRS. A zero denominator is unknown, not 0% success.

title: MatchLab · Recommendation runs
description: Baseline and hybrid side by side. Recall/NDCG use a retrospective next-application proxy with current profiles and current project visibility; they are not unbiased online metrics. No eligible holdout means NULL. Synthetic results do not prove real quality. API latency, impressions and CTR are not collected yet.
